description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git behaviors related to overwriting, untracked files, and various Git commands such as reset, checkout, rebase, stash, and am. It contains multiple test cases that set up different Git repository states and verify the handling of untracked files during these operations.

methods.name: test_setup_reset
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository with specified branches and commits, and sets the working branch.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_setup_checkout_m
methods.description: Sets up a Git repository with specific files, commits, and branches to test checkout behavior.

methods.name: test_setup_sequencing
methods.description: Creates a Git repository with a sequence of commits and branches to test rebase and related commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
